paras: The VALVEX exhaust valve controller empowers you to take full control by opening and closing the factory exhaust valves at the push of the original exhaust valve button. Plugging directly into the existing OEM harness, the VALVEX valve controller is a simple plug and play install, requiring no coding. FEATURES Completely open the exhaust valve in any drive mode, including Comfort. Works in all BMW Drive Modes including Comfort, Sport, Sport+ Toggle between your favourite settings Comfort, M1 & M
